lastAdminLeave: Make someone else an admin first to be able to leave.
stepDownText: You become a regular member and can still start meetings. Only an admin can make you admin again.
leaveText: You will no longer see the association's meetings or get new meeting documents. Documents already shared with you stay in your Drive. You can join again through an invite link.
makeAdminText: They can then change the association's settings, remove members, delete meetings and the association, and make others admin. You stay an admin.
removeAdminText: They become a regular member and can still start meetings.
removeText: They will no longer see the association's meetings or get new meeting documents. Meeting documents already shared with them stay shared – remove the sharing in Google Drive if needed. The invite link still works, so create a new link if they shouldn't be able to join again.
starterFallback: the person who started the meeting
counts: {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {meetings, plural, one {# meeting} other {# meetings}}
activeText: The notes are being written in the meeting document. A new meeting can be started when it has ended.
activeAutoEnd: If nobody is left in the meeting, it ends by itself after a few minutes and the notes are finished.
activeTextLink: The notes are being written in the <link>meeting document</link>. A new meeting can be started when it has ended.
inviteLinkText: Anyone who opens the link and signs in with Google becomes a member and can start meetings.
newLinkText: The old link stops working right away. Existing members aren't affected.
membersText: Can sign in, start meetings and get access to new meeting documents.
settingsMore: Logo, the board, statutes and voices: <link>open Get started</link>.
deleteOrgText: Removes the association with all meetings, transcripts, notes and people here. It can't be undone. The Google Docs stay in Drive.
deleteOrgConfirmText: All meetings, transcripts, notes and people disappear. The Google Docs stay in Drive.
noMeetingsText: When someone starts a meeting, a Google Doc is created in the association's meeting folder (or in the starter's Drive) and shared with the association's members. The meeting shows up here, with a link to the document.
endBeforeDelete: End the meeting before you delete it.
endMeetingText: Recording stops and the notes are finished in the document. What has already been said stays.
deleteMeetingText: The transcript, the notes and the log here are removed. The Google Doc stays in Drive.
meetingsFoot: Deleting a meeting removes the transcript, notes and log here. The Google Doc stays.
meetingsFootEmail: Meeting documents are shared with {email} – open them in Google with that address.
peopleText: Everyone who usually attends the meetings. The names are used to recognise who is speaking. They don't need an account.
peopleBoardLink: <link>Invite by e-mail and set roles under The board</link>.
noPeopleText: Add the people who usually attend. You can also let the name round in the first meeting fill the list.
unnamedMember: Has an account, but no name on the list
removePersonText: The name disappears from the people list. What already stands in the meeting documents doesn't change.
shareTranscript: Share the transcript in the document
shareTranscriptText: The full transcript goes in a tab of its own in the meeting document. Turn this off if you only want to share the notes.
showOnStatus: Show the name on the status page
showOnStatusText: The status page is public. Without the tick it only says "an association" when you have a meeting.
askStarter: Ask {starter} to share the document with you.
